'''Tarnoonga''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

==History==
The seas of Tarnoonga were the homes of giant sea monsters such as the [[Miridon]], who made its nest in the ruins of sunken [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] settled atop the undersea mountain ranges.<ref name="TPOT" /> The peaks of many of these mountains stretched upward, breaking the ocean's surface, forming immense natural caverns and grottos.<ref name="TEA" />

Some years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] known as [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] established a hideaway base inside the depths of one of these tall mountain peaks. His crew horded the purloined treasures from nearby worlds such as [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] and hid them within private caches inside the mountain tops. Kybo kidnapped [[Jann Tosh]] and [[Jessica Meade]], heroes affiliated with Tammuz-an, and brought them to his grotto on Tarnoonga. With the help of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] team of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], however, Tosh and Meade were able to escape.<ref name="TPOT" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] it was a place of confrontation between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[S'ybll]].
